title: Bruh
blurb: Flat, weary, and utterly without drama. Bruh is the most efficient expression of disappointment available in English, and this is the deadpan version that punctuates fails, terrible takes and moments of overwhelming secondhand embarrassment. There is no anger in it and no surprise either, just a man watching something go wrong and declining to elaborate. It has been a load-bearing part of internet vocabulary for a decade and shows no sign of retiring. When words fail you, bruh is still available.
origin: From a viral basketball reaction clip; became the internet's universal disappointment sound.
